\section*{Chapter 1}

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-W01-ra-read}{\textbf{1.1}} \emph{\mw{र} — one sign, and the beginning of a greeting}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} ra\par
\footnotesize \textbf{Also accepted:} r a; \mw{र}
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-W01-aa-matra-change}{\textbf{1.2}} \emph{\mw{ा} — make \emph{ra} into \emph{rā}}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} It changes short a to long ā.\par
\footnotesize \textbf{Also accepted:} makes it aa; lengthens a; long a
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-W01-raam-build}{\textbf{1.3}} \emph{\mw{राम} — your first whole written word}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} \mw{राम} — Ram\par
\footnotesize \textbf{Also accepted:} \mw{राम}; \mw{र} + \mw{ा} + \mw{म}; \mw{रा} + \mw{म}
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-W01-sa-choice}{\textbf{1.4}} \emph{\mw{स} — a second consonant}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} \mw{स}\par
\footnotesize \textbf{Also accepted:} the second sign; sa is \mw{स}
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-W01-saa-build}{\textbf{1.5}} \emph{\mw{सा} — reuse a mark instead of learning a new rule}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} \mw{सा}\par
\footnotesize \textbf{Also accepted:} \mw{स} + \mw{ा}; saa
\end{minipage}\par\medskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\hyperlink{review-MW-C01-raam-raam-saa-greeting-cue}{\textbf{1.6}} \emph{\mw{राम}-\mw{राम} \mw{सा} — your first complete Marwadi greeting}\par
\small \textbf{Answer:} \mw{राम}-\mw{राम} \mw{सा}\par
